mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic output and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% annually and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5pp over the previous 3 months, it signals robust economic growth and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS annual growth > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous 3 months signal a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp and PAYEMS increases > 200k in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% annually and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a supportive monetary environment for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both conditions are met.
